BrochureContent.Content:
iMOVE are delighted to present a stunning 4 bedroom property located in a highly desirable area. This residence offers generous living space and a large rear garden in a most sought after location.

Internally, the property extends to a well-balanced layout comprising bright and spacious reception rooms, a fitted kitchen, four well-proportioned bedrooms and two bathrooms. The accommodation is ideally suited to modern family living, with ample space for growing families and those working from home.

A standout feature of the property is the substantial rear garden, offering excellent privacy and tremendous potential for future extension (subject to planning permission). The garden provides the perfect setting for outdoor entertaining, children's play areas or further landscaping.

Ennafort Road enjoys a superb location in the heart of Raheny, within walking distance of a host of local amenities including excellent primary and secondary schools, neighbourhood shops, cafés, restaurants and sports clubs. St Anne's Park, Bull Island Nature Reserve and the beautiful Dublin coastline are all nearby, providing exceptional recreational opportunities.

The area is exceptionally well served by public transport, with Harmonstown DART Station within easy reach and numerous Dublin Bus routes providing convenient access to the City Centre and beyond. The M1, M50, Dublin Airport and East Point Business Park are also easily accessible.

This is a wonderful opportunity to acquire a spacious family home with a large rear garden in a mature and highly desirable residential setting.
